description: AICTIONBOT™ supplier evidence questions by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T29 (sustainable procurement). From the category (e.g. packaging, logistics, cleaning, IT, electronics, chemicals, wood and paper, textiles, food, energy, construction) it compiles the matching questions: six base questions for every supplier (code of conduct, working conditions in the supply chain, environmental management, greenhouse gas data, integrity, contact person) plus modules per category, each with the evidence to ask for. With a supplier's answers it lists unanswered questions, answers without evidence and answers that were no, as topics for the supplier meeting. No rating, no seal, not legal advice. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

answers.description: Optional supplier answers: id (e.g. B1), answer, evidence (yes/no or name of the document).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.
